tasks.description: Add a light/dark theme toggle control in the application's Settings page. The toggle should immediately switch the active theme. This control should be user-friendly and accessible.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user is on the Settings page, when the theme toggle is clicked, then the active theme is switched.

tasks.description: Persist the user's selected theme to localStorage so the same theme is applied automatically on the user's next visit. This ensures a consistent user experience across visits.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user has selected a theme, when the user closes and reopens the application, then the previously selected theme is applied.

tasks.description: On the first load, when the user has no stored preference, honor the operating system setting via the prefers-color-scheme media query to choose the initial theme. This provides a seamless experience for new users.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user has no stored theme preference, when the application is loaded, then the theme is set based on the operating system's preferred color scheme.

tasks.description: Apply the active theme consistently to all pages and shared components of the application. This ensures a uniform look and feel across the application.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user has selected a theme, when the user navigates to any page or component, then the selected theme is applied consistently.

tasks.description: Verify that the theme toggle works as expected, including persistence and system preference respect. This task involves thorough testing of the theme toggle feature.
acceptance_criteria: Given the theme toggle feature, when tested across different scenarios, then it functions as expected without any issues.
